watermark.$description: Watermark's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--watermark-<name>) on the page, a container or one Watermark, and every Watermark inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text.$description: The mark's color, drawn at `opacity` (text over it keeps 4.5:1).

opacity.$description: How strongly the mark shows (5%). Text over it keeps 4.5:1 in every theme.

font-size.$description: The mark's text size (18px). The room between marks grows with it.

z-index.$description: The stacking level over its own content.

full-page-z-index.$description: The stacking level with `fullPage`: over everything on the page. Modal dialogs, in the top layer, stay above it.
